name: CSBC Corporation
summary: CSBC Corporation operates as a shipbuilding company in Europe, Asia, Africa, and America. The company is involved in the building, manufacturing and repairing of various ships and onshore equipment, ship coating, anti-corrosion coating on large steel structure, surface treatment and professional coating. It also engages in the construction of merchant ships, naval vessels, official ships, and commercial services, large steel structures, machinery manufacturing, offshore engineering manufacturing, assembly, transportation, hoisting, commercial and other core business projects; and large barge and tug business.
